title: Ask the supplier only for prices the shop doesn't have

cases.says: a product with a price on file has that price, from price(...) and from priceOrQuote(...)
a product the shop never listed has an empty price, without an exception, and priceOrQuote asks the supplier for it
a product listed before it has a price has an empty price, without an exception, and priceOrQuote asks the supplier for it
priceOrQuote makes no request to the supplier for a product whose price is on file

origin.section: Put Absence in the Return Type: an Empty Optional or an Empty Collection, Never null
